verdict.rationale: Mollie documents an official hosted MCP server at https://mcp.mollie.com/mcp. It lets merchants use AI tools such as Claude Desktop and Cursor to create and manage resources in their Mollie account with natural language. It covers Payments, Payment Links, Customers, Subscriptions, Balances, Settlements and other APIs, uses scoped tokens, and documents client configurations; a probe confirms the docs page exists. Natural-language operation depends on a third-party AI client, and the tool list omits some areas, such as refunds and chargebacks. Missing for 10: a first-party natural-language interface in the Mollie web app, MCP coverage of refunds and chargebacks, independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP workflow.
